packageRules.description: Overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml are floors for security fixes. A major bump there forces a version no dependency has asked for, and pnpm does not warn.

The pins in KiNorge.Cms.csproj lift transitive packages above Umbraco's own floor (Umbraco 17.7.0 declares Microsoft.OpenApi 2.9.0 and SQLitePCLRaw 2.1.12/2.1.13). 3.x breaks swagger and splits the SQLite family. Remove the rule when Umbraco itself declares 3.x.

Umbraco and uSync can have migrations in minor and patch too (17.5 rewrote links in rich text). They get their own PR, so they are not included in "nuget non-major" without a prod-like test (docs/dependencies.md 5.5). Umbraco 17 is LTS, and 18 is taken as a separate, planned upgrade.
.NET 10 is LTS, and Umbraco 17 builds on it. .NET 11 is taken together with an Umbraco version that supports it.
The digest PRs for the base images sat waiting in the dashboard from July to September and were never created. Microsoft builds new digests for security updates, so they should not wait for maturity.
The Node types follow the runtime, which is Node 24 in CI. Raise to <27 when Node 26 becomes LTS on 2026-10-28 and CI moves there.
@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers 0.22.0 requires vitest ^4.1.0. Remove the rule when it supports vitest 5.
